<div class="card-body">
'''Who's Scruffy-Looking?''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">誰がみすぼらしいって？</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：「みすぼらしいナーフ飼い」、「ウーキーとキスする方がましだわ」、「毛むくじゃら、おかんむり」、「こんなはずじゃあ…」、「死の烙印」、「悲しみの雄叫び」、「タキール」、「ケット・マリス」のいずれかをキャンセルする。2：このターンの終わりまでレネックの戦闘力を2倍にする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Whos-Scruffy-Looking-PSA-85187824.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「照れてるのさ。図星をつかれて怒ったんだ。だろ？」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Who's Scruffy-Looking?.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Cancel Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder, I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee, Furry Fury, This Is Just Wrong, Death Mark, Mournful Roar, Takeel, or Ket Maliss.

2: Double Rennek's power until this turn ends.

'''Lore:'''
"She's just embarrassed. I hit the mark, so she got angry. Right?"

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese names the eight cancel targets, including 死の烙印 and 悲しみの雄叫び.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Who's Scruffy-Looking?]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
